Ingestion.//1: Kept in step with src/XLines.Web/appsettings.json — both hosts run the same scheduler.
Ingestion.//3: Play by play for games in play, MaxFollowedGames every poll (watched games first) and the rest in turn, SlowLanePerPoll a poll (0 leaves them unread), and for finals from before the feed, BackportBatch games every BackportInterval while no game is in play — see the web host's note. Runs wherever the scheduler runs.
Ingestion.//2: A clone ingests nothing until it has a key or ESPN is turned on (//4). With a key for The Odds API and ESPN off, that key is also the stats source: fixtures free, scores 2 credits a league, never unattended unless scanning is Automatic (ADR 0026). Odds need a key — set Enabled=true and an ApiKey on a real odds source, supplied out of band. Until then there is no odds source, which reads as unconfigured rather than as an outage.

TheOddsApi.//Bookmakers: Named books bill as one region and reach Pinnacle, the fair price the others are measured against — see the web host's note.
TheOddsApi.//MarketsBySport: A fight has no spread and its total is in rounds — see the web host's note.

Ingestion.//4: ESPN is the stats source, and off until you turn it on. ESPN's endpoints are unofficial and undocumented. ESPN's terms of use license its services for personal, non-commercial use and prohibit automated access. Turning this on is your decision; use it only to keep data in your own local database, never to host, redistribute or sell it. The MLB Stats API follows this switch. To opt in: Ingestion:Espn:Enabled=true in appsettings.Local.json, or Ingestion__Espn__Enabled=true in the environment (ESPN_ENABLED=true in .env for the Docker stack) — never in this committed file.
